## Motivation

Fixes #42063. Make Ruff editor diagnostics use the project's lint rules.

## Modifications

- Move Ruff rule selection and lint exclusions into root `pyproject.toml`.
- Preserve pre-commit's automatic fixes, existing file scope, and formatter settings.

## Validation

Ruff 0.15.1 checks the same 6,317 files with zero diagnostics. Rule/exclusion probes and commit hooks pass.

files.patch:
@@ -35,20 +35,8 @@ repos:
     hooks:
       - id: ruff
         args:
-          - --select=F401,F821,F823,UP037
           - --fix
         files: ^(benchmark/|docs/|examples/|python/sglang/|sgl-model-gateway/py_*|test/)
-        exclude: |
-          (?x)^(
-          .*/__init__\.py$|
-          .*\.ipynb$|
-          python/sglang/kernels/aot/.*|
-          python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2\.py$|
-          python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2_grpc\.py$|
-          python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2\.pyi$|
-          python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2_grpc\.pyi$|
-          python/sglang/(api|json)/v1/.*\.py$|
-          )$
       - id: ruff-format
         exclude: '^python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2\.py$|^python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2_grpc\.py$|^python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2\.pyi$|^python/sglang/srt/grpc/.*_pb2_grpc\.pyi$|^python/sglang/(api|json)/v1/.*\.py$'
   - repo: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+[tool.ruff]
+# Apply exclusions to explicitly passed files as well as editor diagnostics.
+force-exclude = true
+
+[tool.ruff.lint]
+# Shared by editors and the Ruff pre-commit hook.
+select = ["F401", "F821", "F823", "UP037"]
+exclude = [
+  "__init__.py",
+  "*.ipynb",
+  "python/sglang/kernels/aot/**",
+  "python/sglang/srt/grpc/**/*_pb2.py",
+  "python/sglang/srt/grpc/**/*_pb2_grpc.py",
+  "python/sglang/srt/grpc/**/*_pb2.pyi",
+  "python/sglang/srt/grpc/**/*_pb2_grpc.pyi",
+  "python/sglang/api/v1/**/*.py",
+  "python/sglang/json/v1/**/*.py",
+  # Mirror the global pre-commit exclusions for editor linting.
+  "python/sglang/multimodal_gen/csrc/**",
+  "python/sglang/kernels/ops/diffusion/render/**",
+  "python/sglang/kernels/ops/attention/flash_attn/cute/**",
+  "python/sglang/kernels/jit/csrc/diffusion/vsa_block_sparse_sm100/**",
+]
